author: fable-cursor
criterion: Boulder at the left of shot D reads as layered, mossy rock like the reference, not a smooth blob.
note: There is no boulder reading at the left of D. The whole left foreground is a dark bank of ferns, moss and violets with a smooth pale green trunk across it; the one candidate mass behind the fronds is unlit and indistinguishable from the moss around it (take-0116-W23b-D-boulder-wide.jpg shows the full left foreground). The reference at the same place has a pale grey-tan layered rock about 1 m across, half buried in grass with a moss cap and smaller stones beside it, unmistakably rock. The audit reports 3 hero boulders with geometry procedural-v4-near-lod and mossCoverage true, so the object exists; it is occluded and unlit at the criterion's viewpoint.

history.note: The D boulder (x 0.15-0.30, y 0.62-0.78) is hidden behind fern fronds and sits in shade: a dark grey face with no readable layering, cracks or moss cap. The reference's boulder in the same spot is a lit, layered rock with a moss top and anchors the foreground. Auto gate passes (3 hero boulders, procedural-v4-near-lod, moss); the visual read at D does not. Survey-2 #32 (sn-boulder-shotd: polka-dot lichen and a black hole on top) also still applies at 973a21e.
